ai.summary: The adaptive health-check loop is extracted from the `useConnectionStatus` hook into a new process-wide singleton in `cli/src/utils/connection-monitor.ts`, owned by `createConnectionMonitor` with a lazily created instance accessible via `subscribeToConnectionStatus`. The docstring in `connection-monitor.ts` states that the old hook-level loop reset backoff on every render, which flooded `/api/healthz` (1.17B GETs/week, ~74% of web Render service requests).
